meta.phase-name: Spatial Editor UX and Project Workflow

phase-summary.outcome: Defined the future project/editor workflow for spatial authoring: dedicated spatial project surfaces, warnings-only overlays, linked child records, and import/export boundaries that keep spatial data separate from Space Explorer’s derived-space analysis role.

file.description: Records the editor information architecture and child-record workflow for spatial authoring.

decision.summary: Spatial authoring gets its own project sections instead of being absorbed into Space Explorer.
decision.impact: Future implementation can stay modular and avoid repeating the god-component problem.

tests.test: XML parse validation for 58-03-PLAN.xml and dependent planning docs.

next.action: Move to 58-04 and define the Unreal placement/import/update workflow against the shared spatial contract.

suggestion.gap: REQUIREMENTS.xml does not yet describe a dedicated spatial project surface.
suggestion.proposal: Add a requirement for spatial authoring sections and warnings-only overlay diagnostics within the project workflow.
